scientific_integrity: All mathematical identities and extrema are stated with assumptions; symbolic tests are finite checks and not replacements for analytic global optimality proofs. Possible unlocated equivalent prior optimization and lack of independent scholarly verification are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary two-dimensional overdamped Gaussian harmonic-tweezer model, evaluated coordinatewise; equal trap stiffness k>0, attractive u>0, unit mobility, independent white noises with unequal positive temperatures. Known OU propagators and published angular-current formulas are credited as prior results. Only sharp optimization of peak/integrated temporal antisymmetry is assessed. No finite-sampling, nonlinear, or hydrodynamic universality claimed.
title: Different universal coupling optima for peak and integrated time-asymmetric correlations of two thermostated Brownian particles
